Supplement 第 1–15 页逐页视觉验收
================================

权威 PDF：/workspace/scratch/e34480916f53/completion/project/paper/supplement.pdf
检查图：continuation/review/render/supplement-01.png 至 supplement-15.png。
逐页调用 view_image 实际查看全部十五页，没有用文本抽取代替页面目视。
最终绑定为当前 29 页 supplement.pdf，已核对 render-manifest.json 与实际 PDF
文件校验一致。render-delta.json 确认第 1–28 页 PNG 与此前实际审阅页面逐页
像素一致，仅第 29 页发生变化，第 30 页被删除。因此本报告覆盖的第 1–15 页
沿用已完成的实际逐页审阅，不需要再看一遍；下面的逐页结论直接适用于最终
29 页 PDF。完整路径表和证明内容没有改变，逻辑复核销项继续有效。
检查范围：公式、证明结束符、表格行列和编号、图内文字及连线、页码、两栏
阅读顺序、页尾与浮动体留白。另放大复核第 15 页 Fig. 3 的三条虚线导引。
本次没有修改论文或图源。

总体结果：第 1–15 页全部通过。未发现需要修复的文字压线、模块重叠、公式
越栏、表格截断、编号碰撞、不可读图中文字、异常空页或孤立表格末行。

逐页记录
========
1. 通过。两行标题、作者区、摘要和正文位置清楚；底部作者说明与左栏正文
   不相撞。右栏集合/guard 公式在栏内。页底命题自然接续下一页，没有截字。

2. 通过。Propositions 1–3 与 Theorem 1 层次清楚。距离求和和 k<=W<=|V|-1
   显示完整，数学上下标可读；多个证明结束方框没有压住正文或越出栏界。

3. 通过。长证明两栏衔接顺畅；兼容关系集合、Cartesian products 与 phase
   endpoint 文字均在栏内。小节标题未悬空，页尾无半截公式。

4. 通过。有限 work limits 和 max-closed section 的转接稳定。local relation、
   contiguous limit、greatest endpoint 三组公式有足够行距，右侧 Proposition 5
   与证明完整排至页尾，结束符无碰撞。

5. 通过。monotonicity 证明、guard compilation、复杂度和 difference-bound
   公式均可读；较长 O(...) 项仍在右栏边界内。Section III 标题的两行居中自然。

6. 通过。密集方法与测量说明使用一致字号，两栏无字重或行距突变。新章节和
   小节均带正文，页尾没有单独遗留标题或公式编号。

7. 通过。Tables I、II 两个全宽表格规则线完整，列标题及数值清晰，没有跨页
   行。CPU range / RSS range 的上下界均落在对应列。表格之后两栏正文衔接正常。

8. 通过。Table III 的全部 21 行和 Table IV 的全部路线行完整呈现；budget 与
   缺失项标记位置清楚。两表没有相互压线，下面正文保留合理行距与页底边距。

9. 通过。复现命令表保持两列，等宽字体的 module/argument 字符均未截断。
   Eq. (1) 的求和与下标、V 节标题和说明完整，正文不会侵入列间空隙。

10. 通过。Fig. 1 四个 heatmap 的 panel 标题与各坐标区对齐；数值、limit 斜线
    纹理、公共横轴和色带刻度清楚。图下说明、caption 与正文之间留白正常。
    Eqs. (2)–(4) 各自编号和条件对齐，未靠近页边或正文重叠。

11. 通过。两个 shortest-path 反例的状态序列、竖线分段和 R1/R2 关系完整。
    较长路径没有越栏，论证段落与小节间距统一，底部关系集合没有裁切。

12. 通过。Table V 全宽 caption 较长但完整可读，表头、合计行和横线无碰撞。
    paired-execution 说明与复现命令的换行正常；VI、VII 节均有随后的正文。

13. 通过。Table VI 的 19 个 paired goals 全部在单页内，列头与各统计列对应
    清楚。下方两栏读序正常。普通段尾、右下小节标题及其正文没有孤立或压线。

14. 通过。Table VII 清楚；Fig. 2 的四组 bar、error bars、log ticks、legend
    及样本分母标注可读。误差帽没有被绘图区边界截断。Tables VIII、IX 在左栏
    排列规整，与右栏正文不重叠，数值行与线条间距充足。

15. 通过。Table X 全部路线与毫秒统计完整；Fig. 3 的两块机制说明结构清楚。
    特别放大检查了 Encoder/Transform/Sink 下方虚线：虚线在“One identity…”
    文字行上下分开，未穿过文字；横向箭头落在相邻模块边界，绿色保护框不压字。
    Table XI 与右侧 Section VIII 形成合理的两栏浮动体排布，左栏表下的余白不
    形成孤立表行或缺失正文。页尾的 schema-program 说明正常续至下一页。

逻辑复核销项
============
上一 final-consistency.txt 第 4 项已改为“已关闭”。新增 priority-counterexample
表的四条完整 11 状态路径和分割端点已与 observation.json 逐项核对：四条路径
均 3 phases / 10 installations，exact 为 2 phases / 10 installations。
主稿最新“Independent enumeration verifies both phase costs”与补充材料兑现的
complete paths / unique handoff proof 一致。

RolloutFrontier supplement: final visual acceptance, pages 16--29

Scope and method
----------------
Reviewed the final 29-page PDF at completion/project/paper/supplement.pdf.
Initially opened every supplied PNG from supplement-16.png through
supplement-30.png with view_image. After the final-section compression,
read continuation/review/render-delta.json: pages 16--28 are pixel-identical,
page 29 is changed, and the former page 30 has been removed. The page 16--28
findings below are carried forward only because of that identical-pixel
result. Opened the rebuilt supplement-29.png with view_image and reviewed it
again in full. This is a page-image review, not a text-extraction substitute.
The supplied page images are 918 x 1188 pixels. Rechecked the current PDF
against the refreshed continuation/review/render-manifest.json: its byte
identity matches, the manifest lists 29 pages, and supplement-30.png is absent.
No paper source, generated data, figure or PDF was modified by this review.

Result
------
All 14 final pages in this review pass readability and layout-integrity checks. No clipped
text or formulas, overlapping rules or labels, displaced columns, cropped
table cells, isolated table fragments, unresolved visible references or missing
glyphs were observed. Table text is smaller than body text but remains readable
at the supplied full-page render. The previously recorded terminal-page
whitespace issue is resolved; no open visual issue remains in pages 16--29.

Page-by-page coverage
---------------------
16  PASS. Table XII is centered, complete and readable; its seven column
    headings and six data rows remain distinct. The two compatibility matrices
    fit within the left column. Schema inventory prose and the complete-path
    sequence fit without overprinting. The two columns continue normally.

17  PASS. Table XIII contains all four migration rows in one complete table.
    Proposition 8 states the three/two-phase specialization legibly; the two
    proof cases, intervals, lower-bound reasoning and proof terminator do not
    collide. The threshold constraints in equation (5) fit the right column.
    The combined-portfolio example and the next subsection heading are not
    stranded. Table XV is referenced before its intact appearance on page 18.

18  PASS. Table XIV presents all 15 topology classes with distinct group
    headers, readable mask labels, aligned numeric columns and sufficient row
    separation. Table XV displays all four complete paths and their phase
    endpoints on one page; no path is cropped or wrapped ambiguously. The
    two tables are separate and their captions/rules do not touch. The start
    of Section IX has adequate space and its body continues normally.

19  PASS. Dense runtime-method prose remains readable in both columns. The
    durable-request identity description and workload/measurement definitions
    are uninterrupted by floats. Code-style field names and mathematical
    values fit. Table XVII's forward reference points to the complete duration
    table on page 20. No orphan heading or abnormal internal whitespace.

20  PASS. Tables XVI and XVII are complete, centered, separately captioned and
    legible. All nine execution cohorts and all eight steady-target duration
    rows are visible. Column labels, units, thousands separators and decimal
    values fit their columns. The recovery-control text below both tables is
    normally spaced, with no table fragments at page boundaries.

21  PASS. Independent reconstruction and birth-identity controls fit in the
    left column. Section X and Proposition 9 are legible; the proof terminator
    remains inside the column. Section XI starts with several body lines,
    rather than a stranded heading. The reference to Section XVIII matches
    Current-Source Evidence on pages 26--27.

22  PASS. Evidence-scope, encoding and synthesis material occupies two clean
    columns. The two-line Section XII heading is centered and separated from
    prose. Inline bounds and mathematical expressions do not overrun margins.
    The continued paragraph at the bottom is normal page flow.

23  PASS. Propositions 10--12 and their proofs have readable equations,
    consistent indentation and unobstructed proof terminators. Long inline
    inequalities fit. The labelled-MSS section is visually distinct from the
    preceding batch discussion. No clipping or abnormal whitespace.

24  PASS. The obstruction construction and Proposition 13 are readable; both
    displayed equations have adequate surrounding space. Section XIII begins
    above several body lines, not alone at the foot of the column. The Section
    X reference correctly names the owned transactional application adapter
    shown on page 21. Right-column subsection titles fit in one line.

25  PASS. Tables XVIII and XIX are independently contained within their
    columns. The paired intervals remain readable; the dense synthesis table
    keeps its headers aligned and its refusal rows unambiguous. Neither table
    splits across pages. Section XIV/XV spacing is regular; no displaced float
    or excessively large interior blank region was observed.

26  PASS. Section XVI's two-line heading, Section XVII and Section XVIII are
    consistently styled and separated from the text. Long retained-result
    paths wrap within the columns. Section XVIII has body text following the
    heading on this page. Its preceding forward references resolve visibly.

27  PASS. Tables XX and XXI fit within their respective columns; the matched
    batch/reversed-demand explanation under Table XXI is readable and distinct
    from the rule. All four policy rows are intact. Current-lifecycle premises
    and numerical details fit without compressed or overlapping type. The
    Section XXI forward reference matches page 29.

28  PASS. Figure 4's three compatibility panels have clear A/B/C titles,
    aligned row labels, readable cell values and distinct axis labels. The
    narrow middle matrix is centered under its own title. No label or rule
    overlaps an adjacent panel. The caption fits below the complete figure.
    Table XXII is intact; its W/T/L counts and nine data rows are readable.
    Figure and table references match the displayed numbers.

29  PASS, freshly viewed after rebuilding. Sections XXI and XXII are clearly
    separated. The compatibility equation, minor-version domains, shared
    windows and the 45/23/44 inventory remain readable. Table XXIII retains
    all three witness rows and the 4/9/3 added-vector counts together; formulas
    do not touch column text. The following paragraphs retain 22 locally
    admitted incompatible vectors, three TCP/SQLite lifecycles, 36 installation
    RPCs with three blocked probes, and 12 boundary snapshots. The complete
    upgrade sequence and its two-phase argument fit without clipping. The
    handoff explanation still distinguishes acquiring the new guard, retaining
    the old hold, blocking the conflicting proposal, and retiring the old
    origin. The final paragraph clearly distinguishes five requests, three
    target steps, three installations, two blocks, and 15 snapshots from five
    stores at three cuts; it separately names the 12 boundary snapshots and
    36 proposals. The page ends with the recovery and independent-checker
    statements intact. Both columns finish at almost the same height. No
    table splitting, clipping, stray continuation or oversized blank region.

Resolved observation
--------------------
The prior candidate ended on page 30 with only 105 body words, leaving most
of that page blank. Final-section compression absorbed that prose into page
29 without shrinking the template or splitting Table XXIII. The refreshed
manifest and delta confirm removal of page 30. This issue is closed.

Cross-reference and numbering observations
-----------------------------------------
Visible page numbers proceed consecutively from 16 through 29.
Table XIII (page 17), Tables XIV--XV (page 18), Tables XVI--XVII (page 20),
Tables XVIII--XIX (page 25), Tables XX--XXI (page 27), Table XXII (page 28),
and Table XXIII (page 29) match the nearby prose references reviewed here.
The later Section XVIII and Section XXI references resolve to their visible
headings on pages 26 and 29 respectively. No visible ?? or placeholder was
seen in any of the final page images covered by this review.

This record covers rendered presentation and local reference consistency.
Numerical and semantic claims remain governed by the project's independent
evidence checkers; this visual inspection does not replace those checks.

RolloutFrontier — figure atlas visual review
Review date: 2026-11-19 (UTC)
Reviewer scope: read-only inspection of the nine supplied atlas-page renders,
including the color and grayscale representation on every page, plus the actual
compiled main-paper page 6 containing the revised baseline labels.
Result: PASS for the requested visual checks. No actionable visual defect was
observed in the inspected figures. No project source, figure, or PDF was changed.

Materials and correspondence
----------------------------
Project: /workspace/scratch/e34480916f53/completion/project
Render directory: continuation/review/render/
Viewed individually with view_image:
  figure_atlas-01.png through figure_atlas-09.png (all nine files)
  main-06.png (additional manuscript placement check)
Metadata read: continuation/review/render-manifest.json and
  completion/project/paper/figure_atlas.json.
Final rebind additionally checked: continuation/review/render-delta.json and the
  refreshed render-manifest.json / figure_atlas.json.

The current atlas has nine pages and nine figures: five main-paper figures and
four supplement figures. The main paper has 12 pages; the final supplement has 29.
At the initial metadata cross-check, all nine figure-source digests and all nine
linked document digests matched the current project files. The atlas output
digest agrees with the render manifest. A final check after writing this report
found that supplement.pdf had changed concurrently, while main.pdf and the atlas
still matched the render manifest. The root reviewer was notified. This item is
now CLOSED following the final rebind described below. The visual findings refer
to the explicitly identified inspected renders, which remain valid for all nine
figures because the rebuilt atlas is byte-identical and every atlas-page render
is unchanged.
The atlas records the display dimensions from each imported figure's transform
in the compiled manuscript, rather than choosing an independent gallery scale.
All nine recorded widths are 514.12692 pt = 7.140651667 in. Each atlas page shows
the color vector form and a grayscale rendition at the same recorded dimensions.
This is a review of rendered page images with those print dimensions preserved;
it does not claim an additional physical-paper print inspection.

Reviewed document identities (private review bindings):
  main.pdf
    a7af033d776a503ef397689542c50253db43370eb1e3742dac00be4ad1808f7c
  supplement.pdf
    4d047c871bbe04f9149cbcf77c2e2f284ac62c68841cab629d17a12541d57635

Per-figure coverage
-------------------
1. Atlas page 1 — Main Fig. 1 — goal-overview.pdf
   Main-paper page 3; display size 514.12692 x 239.12880 pt.
   Color: PASS. Grayscale: PASS.
   The physical request, accepted version sets, two protected phases, handoff,
   and double-collection outcomes are legible. Arrows terminate on the intended
   states or handoff objects. The solid, dashed, and dotted path styles remain
   distinguishable in grayscale. The E1/E2 labels do not collide with phase
   outlines. The COMPLETE, PENDING, and DEVIATION outputs remain distinct and
   readable. The three panel headings align with their respective content areas.
   No cropped labels, displaced modules, or unintended line/text intersections
   were observed.

2. Atlas page 2 — Main Fig. 2 — factored-contracts.pdf
   Main-paper page 6; display size 514.12692 x 229.16510 pt.
   Color: PASS. Grayscale: PASS.
   The parser matrix uses both dots/crosses and tone, so acceptance is legible
   without color. Rank labels and the four schema-stage definitions fit cleanly.
   Directed factor edges meet the A, B, and C node boundaries without colliding
   with factor names. The endpoint chain is unambiguous: 0,0,0 to 1,1,1 to 2,2,2
   to 3,3,3, with the three phase intervals stated next to it.
   The revised comparison is explicit: "Exact / stage priority: 3 phases" and
   "Fixed owner priorities: 4 phases". These labels visibly place stage priority
   with the exact result and identify fixed owner priorities as the four-phase
   alternative. Neither color nor formatting implies a gap against stage priority.
   The same comparison was also inspected in main-06.png at its actual manuscript
   placement. Both labels are fully present and legible there.

3. Atlas page 3 — Main Fig. 3 — goal-trap.pdf
   Main-paper page 6; display size 514.12692 x 251.08524 pt.
   Color: PASS. Grayscale: PASS.
   Both coordinate panels, state tuples, phase sets, and objective totals are
   legible. Panel A distinguishes incompatible cells, the dead-end square, and
   the furthest-first dotted route; the stopping marker does not obscure the
   (2,0) label. Solid/dashed/dash-dot phase boundaries can be followed in gray.
   Panel B preserves the double-ring handoff at (0,0), the P and Q paths, and the
   alternative three-install route. The legends and explanatory lines sit outside

   with adequate separation from Fig. 2 and the following manuscript text.

4. Atlas page 4 — Main Fig. 4 — factored-scale.pdf
   Main-paper page 10; display size 514.12692 x 209.23770 pt.

   The two panel titles are centered over their own plotting rectangles. Axis

8. Atlas page 8 — Supplement Fig. 3 — application-contracts.pdf

   The four program rows, accepted symbols, and emitted symbol are aligned and

9. Atlas page 9 — Supplement Fig. 4 — kubernetes-policy.pdf

Disposition
-----------
Coverage: nine of nine figures, eighteen of eighteen color/grayscale presentations,
plus the revised comparison's main-paper placement. Every requested visual item

No visual fix is requested by this review. No claim about scientific validity,
